messages:
luis-gonzalez: Kickoff: bootstrapping mex1 GPU fleet today 14:00 UTC. Need runbook review + perf validation owners. Target capacity 40 T4s (burst to 60) and 8 A10G for inference.

anya: :thumbsup: I can own kernel/driver checks and NVLink sanity. Will run module smoke and nvlink topology.

ben: I'll take throughput baselines (gRPC/text-gen p50/p95) and batching profile. Will run our `serving_profile.py` bench.

sam: I'll handle networking checks (MTU, SR-IOV, subnet routes) and a rough cost delta for the region.

luis-gonzalez: Quick runbook summary we should validate: 1) node image bake (driver 535.86, CUDA 12.2) 2) deploy k8s nodes with GPU taints/labels 3) kernel modules load + `nvidia-smi` smoke 4) microbench kernels (matrix mul / tiny-lm) 5) perf harness (p50/p95, tokens/s) 6) soak on canary 4h+ 7) handoff doc + dashboards. Call out anything missing.

anya: Two immediate asks: confirm kernel 6.1.x is the target (we've seen regressions with 6.4 on this driver combo), and ensure `nvidia-fabricmanager` is not started on T4s. I'll include `nvidia-smi topo --matrix` in checks.

ben: Perf script we'll use: `bench/gpu/serving_profile.py --model vicuna-7b --concurrency 12 --seq 1024 --output /tmp/mex1.csv` . Expected numbers: A10G p95 ~220ms, T4 p95 ~380-420ms (depending on batching). I'll upload results to s3://redwood-perf/mex1/.

ops-runbot: Canary pool created: `mex1-canary` (4 nodes). Healthchecks passed: node-ready, kube-proxy ok, taints applied. Will post deploy completion.

infra-bot: Node images signed and uploaded as `mex1-node-image:v1.2`. SHA256: abc123... (truncated). Image scan status: PASS.

maya: Networking note: provider enforces ~25Gbps per-host NIC limit in mex1. We observed packet drops during high-concurrency tests previously. Recommend `tcp_congestion_control=bbr` and tune NIC driver rings. Also confirm MTU 9000 across racks.

sam: I'll validate MTU 9000 and run `iperf3 -c` intra-rack; target p95 latency <1ms. Will also validate calico performance (IPIP vs WireGuard) and SR-IOV configuration.

anya: Kernel check quick pass: kernel `6.1.76-rt` + driver `535.86` loaded. Ran `dmesg | tail` — saw one GPU reset on initial boot: `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3a:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus.` Marking for follow-up. Ran `nvidia-smi topo --matrix` — NVLink topology OK. `nvidia-fabricmanager` disabled on T4s.

ben: First perf run results uploaded: s3://redwood-perf/mex1/bench-1975312100.csv  Summary: A10G p50=110ms p95=235ms throughput=140 tokens/s. T4 p50=210ms p95=410ms throughput=62 tokens/s. Batching + autotune improved T4 p95 by ~18%. Raw CSV + scripts in the same S3 path.

luis-gonzalez: Good data. Action items: anya investigate the GPU reset (Xid 79); sam confirm MTU + enable BBR if needed; ben start an 8h soak on the canary; maya escalate with provider re: NIC drops. If soak passes we'll prepare EOD handoff.

maya: Provider ticket opened: PROV-4921 — host NIC queue drops at peak. Provider ETA 48h to validate firmware/routing.

ops-runbot: Soak started at 2026-03-18T16:30Z on `mex1-canary`. Expected duration 8h. Healthcheck cadence every 60s, alerts to #eng-oncall.

ben: Quick cost note: estimated hourly burn for mex1 when fully provisioned (40 T4 + 8 A10G) ~ $32/hr (T4 pool ~$23/hr, A10G pool ~$9/hr). I'll attach calc sheet to the handoff doc.

anya: Small node change: adding `modprobe nvidia_uvm` in systemd pre-start and ensure `ulimit -n >= 65536` for the container runtime. Recommend adding to node startup script.

luis-gonzalez: Thanks team. If anything blocks handoff ping #eng-oncall. I'll prepare the handoff doc + perf dashboard links: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/mex1 and draft the rollout window. Handoff tentative at EOD if soak shows no regressions.

ben: I'll post a short CSV summary + grafana snapshot to the handoff doc when soak reaches 4h.

anya: Filing a small bug: if GPU reset reproduces on next reboot I'll open infra-ticket. For now marking as low-sev until we see trend.

luis-gonzalez: Perfect — thanks everyone.
